hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Eastern Africa, bordering the Gulf of Aden and the Indian Ocean, east of Ethiopia || mostly flat to undulating plateau rising to hills in north || strategic location on Horn of Africa along southern approaches to Bab el Mandeb and route through Red Sea and Suez Canal || Resources: uranium and largely unexploited reserves of iron ore, tin, gypsum, bauxite, copper, salt, natural gas, likely oil reserves || Exports: sheep and goats, gold, postage stamps/documents, other animals, cattle (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly flat to undulating plateau rising to hills in north || Eastern Africa, bordering the Gulf of Aden and the Indian Ocean, east of Ethiopia

climate.excerpt: principally desert; northeast monsoon (December to February), moderate temperatures in north and hot in south; southwest monsoon (May to October), torrid in the north and hot in the south, irregular rainfall, hot and humid periods (tangambili) between monsoons || recurring droughts; frequent dust storms over eastern plains in summer; floods during rainy season

economy.excerpt: low-income African Horn economy; 30 years of war and instability crippled economic potential; high remittances for basic survival; new fiscal federalism approach; cleared some unsustainable debt; environmentally fragile; digitally driven urbanization efforts || Exports: sheep and goats, gold, postage stamps/documents, other animals, cattle (2023) || Industries: light industries, including sugar refining, textiles, wireless communication

peopleAndCulture.excerpt: Muslim 99.9% (Sunni Muslim 98.1%, Shia Muslim 1.2%, Islamic schismatic 0.6%), ethnic religionist 0.1% (2020 est.) || predominantly Somali with lesser numbers of Arabs, Bantus, and others
